    def assert_error(self, result, code, path):
        resp, exit_code = result

    def test_example_1_call_with_params(self):
        request = {
            "defs": {
                "Normalize": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "z", "expr": "(value - params.mean) / params.std"}]},
                "KeepCols": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "z"]}]},
            },
            "pipeline": {"steps": [
                {"op": "call", "name": "Normalize", "params": {"mean": 100, "std": 20}},
                {"op": "call", "name": "KeepCols", "params": {}},
            ]},
            "dataset": [{"id": 1, "value": 120}, {"id": 2, "value": 80}],
        }
        self.assertEqual(execute(request), ({"status": "ok", "data": [{"id": 1, "z": 1}, {"id": 2, "z": -1}],
                                             "metrics": {"rows_in": 2, "rows_out": 2}}, 0))

    def test_normalized_output(self):
        request = {"defs": {"A": {"steps": [{"op": " Limit ", "n": 1}]}, "Unused": {"steps": []}},
                   "pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "CALL", "name": "A"}]}, "dataset": []}
        self.assertEqual(run(request), ({"status": "ok", "normalized": {
            "defs": {"A": {"steps": [{"op": "limit", "n": 1}]}, "Unused": {"steps": []}},
            "steps": [{"op": "call", "name": "A", "params": {}}]}}, 0))
        self.assertEqual(run(req([])), ({"status": "ok", "normalized": {"steps": []}}, 0))

    def test_params_outside_call_and_missing_params_are_null(self):
        request = {"defs": {"A": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "y", "expr": "params.nope"}]}},
                   "pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "map", "as": "x", "expr": "params.k"},
                                          {"op": "call", "name": "A", "params": {"k": 1}}]},
                   "dataset": [{"params": 5}]}
        self.assertEqual(execute(request)[0]["data"], [{"params": 5, "x": None, "y": None}])

    def test_nested_calls_restore_params(self):
        request = {"defs": {
            "Outer": {"steps": [{"op": "call", "name": "Inner", "params": {"v": 2}},
